question: Which V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically, how many ALD cycles gave the thicker film, and did the potential shifts differ between them?
expect: ~80 nm (1000 ALD cycles, Fig. 3 caption p4.L61) and ~40 nm; similar ΔEeq(avg) shifts (~40 mV) for both, owing to similar locked-in strains (p4.L40-44)
rendered: According to the text, the V2O5 film thicknesses tested electrochemically were ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm. The thicker film was achieved with 1000 ALD cycles. The potential shifts did not differ between the two film thicknesses, as the average equilibrium potential (ΔEeq(avg)) variation with imposed strains showed similar shifts for both ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm V2O5 films.
